title: bronze_ingest_wgi's parameters-cell comment is misleading — no Fabric parameter actually overrides p_start_year/p_end_year
description:
bronze_ingest_wgi's first cell is commented 'Pipeline parameters — overridden by Fabric pipeline at runtime', but the pipeline (per pipeline-content.json) passes NO parameters to this notebook, and the notebook has no Fabric parameters cell (the `# PARAMETERS CELL ********************` marker, per project memory on how Fabric actually serializes parameter cells). p_start_year/p_end_year are therefore permanently the hardcoded 1996/2023 values in the file — a future maintainer could read the comment, believe changing a pipeline parameter moves the WGI ingestion window, and be wrong.

This is unlike bronze_epi, which DOES receive pipeline parameters (confirmed during task-066's self-review). The fix is a comment correction, not a behavior change — unless the intent is for the window to actually be parameterized, in which case that's a bigger question for Erik, not an implicit scope expansion here.
acceptanceCriteria: The misleading comment is corrected to state plainly that p_start_year/p_end_year are hardcoded and not overridden by any pipeline parameter, contrasting with bronze_epi's actual parameterization if that helps a future reader.

No behavior change — this is a documentation/comment fix only, unless Erik indicates during review that the window should actually become parameterized (in which case that's a scope decision, not an assumption).
